Sanitation is critical in every step. I use a non rinse powder that hasn't failed me yet. If it touches the water/wort it gets cleaned.

Water quality is important and often overlooked. Here is a good link to get you thinking about it. It has a spreadsheet you can plug a ton of information into and it will spit out other information.
